title: Feature delivery
summary: Move an approved feature from deterministic planning through agent handoff, review and packet verification.

steps.description: Confirm scope, risks and the profile before running the feature workflow.
Review the selected requirements, practices and gates.
Have an agent prepare implementation-oriented design evidence without changing the compiled policy.
Approve the plan and the declared implementation evidence before code changes begin.
Compile the approved profile into a portable VLD packet.
Implement against requirement anchors and packet gates; do not claim completion without executable evidence.
Validate the compiled packet before its generated CI guards are accepted.
Review requirement anchors, test results and residual risk before release.
